phase: Phase 28: Dedicated UI/UX Evolution (Design System Foundations)

stories.title: Compose Material 3 Expressive Tokens, Neobrutalist & Claymorphic Modifier Engine
stories.description: Establish the foundational design system in :app:sharedUI adhering to ADR-014. Implements IntercomDesignTokens.kt with M3 Expressive color schemes (Tactile Dark/High-Contrast Light, Neon Signal Accents: Tactical Amber #FF9F0A, International Orange #FF453A, Emergency Crimson #FF3B30, Coded PHY Emerald #30D158), expressive typography with tabular numbers, and custom Compose Modifier extensions in TactileModifiers.kt (claymorphic double inner/outer depth shadows, crisp 2dp neobrutalist outlines, and frosted liquid-glass blur overlays).
acceptanceCriteria: IntercomDesignTokens defines comprehensive color roles, typography, shape scales (M3 Expressive squircles), and tactile dimension tokens
TactileModifiers provides reusable Compose Modifiers: .claymorphic(), .neobrutalistBorder(), and .liquidGlass()
Zero AI template code: pure hand-crafted Compose canvas drawing, layout modifiers, and shadow layering
100% test coverage for token metrics, contrast ratios, and modifier composition across JVM and Android targets

stories.title: iOS SwiftUI Tactical Design System, Liquid Glass & Tactile Haptic Modifiers
stories.description: Establish the native iOS 18+ SwiftUI design system foundation in :app:iosApp (strictly adhering to Rule 1: No Compose on iOS). Implements TactileDesignSystem.swift, LiquidGlassView.swift, and TactileHaptics.swift providing .claymorphicDepth(), .neobrutalistOutline(), .liquidGlassBackground(), and high-performance UIImpactFeedbackGenerator / UINotificationFeedbackGenerator tactile actuation triggers for heavy gloves.
acceptanceCriteria: 100% native SwiftUI without shared Compose UI (Rule 1)
Provides liquid glass ultraThinMaterial overlays with specular edge reflections
Provides claymorphic tactile depth modifiers and 2pt high-contrast neobrutalist borders
Tactile haptic engine with low-latency rigid and heavy impact patterns for gloved riding

stories.title: Expressive Tactical Audio & Cockpit Widget Components (PTT, VU Meter, SOS Switch)
stories.description: Build production-grade tactile cockpit components fusing Skeuomorphism, Claymorphism, Neobrutalism, and Liquid Glass. On Android (:app:sharedUI): ExpressivePttActuator.kt (recessed knurled bevel, spring-damped deformation, dynamic ripple), ExpressiveVuMeter.kt (phosphor decay, peak hold, clipping alerts), and GuardedSosSwitch.kt (spring-loaded flip cover). On iOS (:app:iosApp): matching native SwiftUI TactilePttActuator.swift, TactileVuMeter.swift, and GuardedSosSwitch.swift.
acceptanceCriteria: Oversized 84x84dp minimum touch target bounding boxes for gloved operation
Tactile deformation animation with spring damping physics
Real-time audio VU meter with phosphor decay and clip indicator
Guarded SOS switch requiring deliberate flip-guard gesture before triggering emergency

stories.title: Design System Verification Harness & Archify Visual Specification Update
stories.description: Implement multiplatform test suite DesignSystemTokenTest.kt validating token contracts, color contrast ratios, accessibility sizes, and component bounds. Updates docs/architecture/intercom-alpha.architecture.json and intercom-alpha-architecture.html showcasing Phase 28 Design System Foundations with 10/10 verified checks.
acceptanceCriteria: All design tokens and modifier contracts verified via automated tests
Clean Gradle test passes across JVM and Android targets
Clean iOS simulator compilation for SwiftUI design system
Archify architecture specification updated to v3.0.0-alpha1 with design system validation
